name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.decodeN_some
typeText:
∀ {α : Type} (f : List.{0} Bool → Option.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} α (List.{0} Bool))) (enc : α → List.{0} Bool),
  (∀ (l : List.{0} Bool) (a : α) (rest : List.{0} Bool),
      Eq.{1} (f l) (Option.some.{0} (Prod.mk.{0, 0} a rest)) → Eq.{1} l (HAppend.hAppend.{0, 0, 0} (enc a) rest)) →
    ∀ (n : Nat) (l : List.{0} Bool) (as : List.{0} α) (rest : List.{0} Bool),
      Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.decodeN f n l) (Option.some.{0} (Prod.mk.{0, 0} as rest)) →
        And (Eq.{1} (List.length.{0} as) n)
          (Eq.{1} l (HAppend.hAppend.{0, 0, 0} (List.flatten.{0} (List.map.{0, 0} enc as)) rest))

source.code:
theorem decodeN_some (f : List Bool → Option (α × List Bool)) (enc : α → List Bool)
    (hf : ∀ l a rest, f l = some (a, rest) → l = enc a ++ rest) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : List Bool) (as : List α) (rest : List Bool),
      decodeN f n l = some (as, rest) → as.length = n ∧ l = (as.map enc).flatten ++ rest
  | 0, l, as, rest, h => by
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := pureP_some h
      simp
  | n + 1, l, as, rest, h => by
      simp only [decodeN] at h
      obtain ⟨a, l₁, h1, h2⟩ := bindP_some h
      obtain ⟨as', l₂, h3, h4⟩ := bindP_some h2
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := pureP_some h4
      obtain ⟨hlen, hl⟩ := decodeN_some f enc hf n l₁ as' rest h3
      refine ⟨by simp [hlen], ?_⟩
      rw [hf l a l₁ h1, hl]
      simp
